name: Indian Heliotrope
desc: Indian Heliotrope (Heliotropium indicum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Heliotropium indicum, commonly known as Indian heliotrope or Indian turnsole, is an annual, hirsute plant. It has a curved arrangement of small flowers and velvety broad green leaves.
